units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 41:7">Targ. Job XLI, 7</cite> <he>מַתְרִיסִין</he> Var. ed. Lag. (ed. <he>תְּרֵיסִין</he> noun).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3:16">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ</cite> top <he>ולא על יאות … מְתָרֵס לקיבליה</he> but R. Ḥ. opposed him improperly; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:4:5">Y. Dem. III, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ולא עאל יאות … מַתְרִיס לקבל</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:1:6">Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>לא דריש לקיש מַתְרִיס לקבל וכ׳</he> not that R. L. opposed R. J. because they differed in theory, but &c.
Tam. 32ᵃ מה דין אַתְרִיסְתּוּן לקבלי (Rashi אִיתְרִ׳ Ithpe.) why, now, did you oppose me?

senses.gloss: to put on armor. Y. Kidd. III, 63ᵈ והוה … מתרס כליו וכ׳ and R. Ḥ. put his armor on against (took up a debate with) &c.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 111a">B. Bath. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>השתא איכו נח</he> … <he>אִיתְרִיסַת לקבלי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>השתא כי</he>) now if R. H. were dead, you might have opposed me (by referring to his authority).
